lines.text: `refresh` keeps a hunk whose path and changed lines are the same, wherever it now starts, and re-points its ref. A hunk edited in place (same file, same region, other lines) is `changed` and keeps its group; when only whitespace moved it is `reformat`. A ref whose hunk left the diff is dropped. Every hunk no group covers lands in a draft `update` group with stub prose, and so does every new hunk under a directory ref. A focus range or note follows a `same` hunk to its new lines. One on a `changed` or `reformat` hunk is dropped, and the report names its group; one on a `gone` hunk is dropped. A file note stays while every hunk of its file is `same`. When its file gains, edits, or loses a hunk, the note is dropped and the report counts it; one on a file that left the diff is dropped. The report prints the new commit subjects, one line per file whose hunks changed (`new`, `changed`, `reformat`, `same`, `gone`, and the groups it sits in), and per group what moved. "nothing to refresh" means the refs still resolve to the commits the document names: fetch the right remote or name the head, then run it again. Done when the report and the document are in context.

lines.text: 4. Edit `review.json` in place with your edit tool; untouched groups stay verbatim. Move each `update` ref into the group that holds its concern, or into a new group, then delete `update`. In a group the report names: rewrite `summary` when the new or changed hunks change what the group is; drop an `attention` whose hunks are `gone`; re-check an `attention` on a `changed` hunk against the fetched hunk; re-check each question the report counts, and when a new source answers it, put the answer in `why` and drop the question; write a dropped focus range, note, or file note again from the fetched hunk when that hunk still needs it. A group the report lists under `lookFor to convert to attention` gets its one judgment call as `attention`, and its `lookFor` field goes. A named group whose hunks keep their meaning, such as one with only `reformat` hunks, keeps its prose as it is. Delete a group that is `now empty`, and every `dependsOn` that names it. Retire a document `lookFor` bullet that a new commit resolves; a new comment asking for work the change does not do is a new bullet. `size` moves with the new burden; `title` and `why` change only when a source did. Done when `update` is gone, no group is empty, no stub prose remains, and every named group's prose matches the code at head.
